nom: PanOxyl PM Blemish Aftercare Brightening Patches

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the removal process can hurt and that the patches were extremely hard to take off, though others with sensitive skin note the fragrance-free formula and lack of irritation as a plus.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin applies the patches to clean skin for better grip and reports dark spots fading faster than usual.
segments.mature: A 35-year-old reviewer treating chin acne marks reports a modest but noticeable improvement, mainly in redness, and appreciated the perforated design for customizing patch size.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report dark spots or scars fading or lightening with consistent use over several days to a week and a half; several say results are gradual rather than dramatic, and at least three report no visible fading at all.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers describe the patches pulling gunk from active pimples and reducing swelling or size overnight; a few say they saw no reduction in blemishes and one found no effect on traditional breakouts.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report visibly reduced redness after overnight wear, including for stubborn papules; one reviewer explicitly saw no reduction in redness compared to surrounding skin.
concerns.aging: One reviewer in her 30s used the patches on chin acne marks and saw improvement mainly in redness rather than dramatic brightening.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note no irritation or discomfort upon removal, but others describe skin hurting when patches are pulled off, and one reports the patches irritate her skin enough that she cannot wear them back-to-back.

aspects.libelle: Difficult to peel from plastic backing
Painful or hard to remove from skin
Large triangular size covers multiple spots
Few patches per box for the price

extraits.texte: Honestly, I didn't really care for these patches. I left them on overnight per the instructions and I didn't really see any difference. When I woke up in the morning, they were extremely hard to takeoff and really hurt my sensitive skin.

Did you think PanOxyl was for teenagers only? Think it didn't have anything to offer adults? That's exactly what I thought before trying the PanOxyl Blemish Aftercare Brightening Patches, and I was pleasantly surprised. At 35, I used these on acne marks around my chin, where I break out the most. While I didn't see a dramatic change, I did see improvement. I noticed the biggest change in the amount of redness. I really like the perforated design because it made it easy to customize the patch size. They were comfortable to wear and they stayed in place. My only downside is that there aren't very many patches in the box for continuous treatment. Therefore I wasn't able to use them long enough for significant results. Overall, I was impressed and I will purchase them in the future. I recommend them for anyone looking to reduce redness and increase brightness.

PanOxyl has always been my go-to for my acne. I get a few pimples every now and then, so these patches come in handy for those stubborn dark spots that stay behind. They are very clear but you can notice them when light reflects on it. For me it's very comfortable, more than any acne patch I've used before. And I've tried tons because of my hormonal acne! I don't have any residue left when I remove the patch. I have combination skin so I always apply it on clean skin to have a better grip. My dark spots have been fading much quicker than usual, and that's thanks to PanOxyl!

These patches are working pretty well for me. You can see that haven't made the spots go away entirely but it does seem to be fading. I'm not sure how many times it will take for it to fully go away. They do irritate my skin some so I can't wear them back to back. But overall the seem to work pretty good.

So I struggle with acne and redness a lot. I decided to try out just sleeping in a couple of the patches and the results were quite noticeable! I also appreciate their being lines to cut the patches if you only need half a patch!

extraits.titre: Panoxyl exceeding expectations, every single time! 🩵
extraits.texte: What i like most is that they actually help with those annoying derk marks that hang around after a breakout. They dont feel heavy or irritating on the skin, which is a big win you have sensitive skin.

I really wanted to like these PanOxyl Blemish Aftercare Brightening Patches, the size of the patches is great but there were two main reasons I couldn't entirely like them: they didn't seem to do what they advertised to do, which was be brightening aftercare patches that help with red spots and dark spots. I did not really notice any brightening effect not did it reduce redness covered by the triangle compared to skin around the patch. They work great as regular pimple patches but that's about it. Although the big size is great in theory, I'm not sure if it is due to the triangle shape or that fact the patches are so big, but in certain places on the face
